name: The Meridian Frequency
motto: Every signal finds its receiver. Every receiver finds its signal.
description: The Meridian Frequency grew out of something almost accidental: in 2178, a VANTABLACK MEDIA broadcast engineer named Cass Tondeur discovered that OUROBOROS ENERGY's power grid management system was broadcasting low-frequency carrier signals through the neural augmentation infrastructure of the entire GLMZ corridor — not transmitting data, exactly, but maintaining a persistent background hum that OUROBOROS had registered as a 'network stability protocol' in filings so dense with technical language that no Quorum auditor had ever parsed them to the bottom. Tondeur, whose augmentation was sensitive enough to feel the hum as a kind of persistent pressure behind her left eye, began pulling at the thread. What she found was that the protocol could be repurposed: it was a passive two-way channel, and with the right equipment, anyone with standard-issue neural augmentation could receive and transmit on it without going through any corporate communication node.
ideology: The Frequency holds that communication is the foundational infrastructure of personhood and that any entity — corporate or civic — that controls the channels through which people speak to one another controls not just information but identity and consent. They are not anarchists in any traditional sense; they do not object to organization or hierarchy as such. They object to the specific arrangement in which VANTABLACK MEDIA determines what stories exist, OUROBOROS determines what signals travel, and TESSERA determines who counts as a person with standing to receive either. Their goal is a communication layer that no single entity can own, and they are willing to be parasitic about achieving it — riding OUROBOROS's own infrastructure toward that end with something that looks, from the outside, almost like satisfaction.
territory: The Circuit is their operational heart, where tuner workshops and broadcast nodes cluster in the dense electronics district. They maintain relay infrastructure throughout Old Harbor and The Laceworks, with a significant presence in Substation Null where proximity to OUROBOROS grid hardware gives their engineers direct access to carrier wave amplification points. Increasingly active in The Meridian Core's lower commercial tiers.
leadership:
Decentralized by design. The Frequency operates through 'bands' — autonomous cells of 8-15 members each focused on a specific function (tuning, broadcasting, journalism, security, engineering). Bands coordinate through the open channel itself, using a rotating consensus protocol that Tondeur designed specifically to prevent any single voice from becoming a permanent authority.

methods: Carrier wave exploitation: repurposing OUROBOROS's passive grid management signal as an unmonitored communication channel across the full neural augmentation network
Tuning operations: subtle, reversible modifications to standard neural augmentation allowing access to the Frequency channel without corporate communication nodes
Open sessions: unmoderated collective broadcasts allowing simultaneous multi-party transmission across the channel
Investigative journalism: dedicated broadcast bands producing documented reporting on corponation activity, leaked internally and to external press
Signal masking: technical countermeasures that make Frequency transmissions appear as routine grid noise to OUROBOROS monitoring systems
Black-market data auctions: encrypted sales of sensitive corporate data conducted through the channel's auction protocol
Counter-broadcast: targeted signal disruption of VANTABLACK MEDIA programming during high-profile corporate events or propaganda cycles
resources: Passive access to OUROBOROS ENERGY's entire GLMZ grid management carrier wave infrastructure
A network of tuners capable of modifying standard neural augmentation in under 40 minutes with no specialized equipment
Dov Marchetti's original RINGO CORPONATION internal affairs archive, still only partially published
Workshop space throughout The Circuit and Substation Null proximity zones
A loyal listener base estimated at 200,000-400,000 active augmentation users across all tiers
Technical expertise in OUROBOROS, ZHENG-DAO BIOELECTRIC, and HELIX BIOSYSTEMS augmentation architecture

relationships.description: OUROBOROS knows the Frequency exists and knows approximately how it operates. They cannot shut it down without either admitting the carrier wave's existence to regulators or destabilizing their own grid management. They have instead pursued targeted elimination of tuners and relay nodes, which the Frequency's decentralized structure has so far absorbed. The situation is a grudging technical standoff.

The Frequency represents an existential threat to VANTABLACK's audience capture model. The open channel's structural resistance to segmentation means it cannot be monetized, surveilled, or redirected — everything VANTABLACK's infrastructure is built to do. VANTABLACK has lobbied the Quorum to classify Frequency broadcasts as unlicensed neural interference and funds bounty networks targeting Tondeur specifically.

Tuning modifications are technically unauthorized alterations to ZHENG-DAO hardware, voiding warranties and threatening the company's augmentation service contract model. ZHENG-DAO has begun embedding detection firmware in new augmentation units specifically designed to identify and report Frequency-modified hardware.

The two factions share a constituency and a philosophy of reclaiming infrastructure from corporate ownership. The Hollow Census uses Frequency channels for secure internal communication; the Frequency has broadcast several Recount datasets. The relationship is warm but not formalized.

Null Sermons has begun broadcasting its own signal content through the open channel, which the Frequency's consensus structure cannot easily block without violating its own principles. The content is unsettling to many band members but the philosophical commitment to an uncensored channel has so far prevented any move to exclude them.

Dov Marchetti's archive has already cost Ringo two regulatory investigations and one senior executive. Ringo maintains an active contract with ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS to locate and destroy the remaining unpublished archive contents and eliminate Marchetti if possible.

A minority bloc finds the Frequency's journalism useful for building cases against corponation overreach. The majority view them as a destabilizing illegal broadcaster. No formal position has been adopted, which the Frequency interprets as a quiet acknowledgment that the carrier wave issue is too complicated for the Quorum to want to open officially.

story_hooks: A player's neural augmentation begins receiving Frequency transmissions without having been tuned — suggesting either a ZHENG-DAO firmware vulnerability no one has mapped yet, or that someone tuned them without their knowledge.

Dov Marchetti's unpublished archive contains documentation that doesn't just implicate RINGO CORPONATION — it implicates a current Meridian Quorum representative in a labor trafficking arrangement. Marchetti wants help deciding whether to publish and surviving the aftermath if he does.

OUROBOROS ENERGY has quietly hired a team of signal engineers to develop a carrier wave modification that would allow them to broadcast directly into the neural augmentation of every Frequency user simultaneously — essentially a backdoor into 200,000-400,000 people's heads. The Frequency has one week before the modification goes live.

An open session broadcast has been carrying a repeating signal embedded in the background noise — not Frequency content, not OUROBOROS grid data. Something else. The Substation Null Collective wants someone to trace it before the next session, because they're not sure what happens if it completes its cycle.

Cass Tondeur has gone quiet. Three bands have tried to reach Static through the channel and received nothing. The last confirmed sighting placed her near the Vantage Meridian Corporate Campus, which makes no sense — unless she found something in the original OUROBOROS filings she never told anyone about.
